motivating_deficit.statement: No party outside Project FAR has ever chosen or evaluated a preservation contract for the universality question. The OP-21 comparison reconstructed six independently motivated external contracts, but the dimension set, the scoring, and the placement were all performed with knowledge of the target contract's profile.
motivating_deficit.why_internal_work_cannot_close_it: The deficit is definitionally about the absence of an external party. USD-W6 established that one agent can isolate computational paths but cannot create human or organizational independence, terminating at internal_robustness_only. No internally authored bridge can close LIM-031.

consumed_dispositions.note: Reconstructed from origin/main at evidence_base_sha (see provenance_sha_model). Recorded so that a later change to any of these is detectable as a premise change.
consumed_dispositions.OP-21: Executed and corrected. H5 supported; H1 not established; H2 NOT established; H3 and H4 unresolved; H6 split. Terminal classification E+F. No global comparison relation over contracts is established.
consumed_dispositions.UQ-T25: H5 supported jointly with H2 withdrawn. Every P* component independently anticipated; the conjunction is not independently recovered.
consumed_dispositions.UQ-T26: Unresolved and not answerable internally. No dominance relation over contracts is established at all.
consumed_dispositions.LIM-031: Open, and the dominant deficit. Strengthened by the OP-21 correction.
consumed_dispositions.G2: Established. Quantified lower bound over an arbitrary Candidate type, conditional on admissibility, machinery closure, and full faithfulness. Contract-relative to P*/E*.
consumed_dispositions.IKD-W9: Bounded RCCD universality theorem supported internally for C, P, E as registered.
consumed_dispositions.TUE-W4: maximal_effective_rccd_universality for the registered natural class; unrestricted question evidentially underdetermined.
consumed_dispositions.FAR-CANONICAL-UNIVERSALITY-DECISION-001: terminal_for_current_evidence; G1/G2/G3 established; six canonical bridges not_established; verdict not_derivable; not proved and not refuted.
consumed_dispositions.USD-W6: internal_robustness_only. Explicitly not independent proof review, not R3, not R4, not R5.
consumed_dispositions.evidence_rules_R3_R4_R5: R3 requires a separate implementation team or organization with independent code and verifier paths, artifact isolation, and deterministic comparison. R4 requires independently designed alternatives and counterexamples. R5 requires a new reasoning context and an independently defined source contract.

what_this_program_is: Construction and freezing of an elicitation protocol. It is not evidence collection. No participant exists. No result is registered.

frozen_question_reference.superseded: elicitation-packet-B-mutation-v1.0.md, removed: it reproduced the A-I axes while also introducing a substantive pragmatic criterion, so it was simultaneously too structurally similar and too semantically different.
frozen_question_reference.participant_surface: participant-surface-v1.1.json defines the COMPLETE participant-facing surface.

outcome_space.note: Pre-registered before execution. No outcome is scored as supporting Project FAR by default. Outcomes are descriptive classifications, not verdicts.
outcome_space.O1: Independent formulation substantially equivalent to the project's target contract.
outcome_space.O3: Independently derived formulation strictly stronger under criteria the participant independently supplied.
outcome_space.O4: Independently derived formulation strictly weaker under criteria the participant independently supplied.
outcome_space.O5: Formulations incomparable under criteria the participant independently supplied.
outcome_space.O9: Participant concludes the underlying question is malformed.
outcome_space.O10: Participant cannot derive a stable formulation.

falsification_conditions.note: Each condition is classified by what evidence it actually needs. No numeric threshold is invented where none can be justified.

classes.SINGLE_RUN_TESTABLE: One qualifying run can bear on it.
classes.MULTI_RUN_CUMULATIVE: Requires repeated runs; a single run contributes one data point and cannot establish it.
classes.NOT_OPERATIONALIZED: No defensible threshold exists yet; may not be claimed either way.

F1.statement: Repeated independent formulations systematically omit one of the target contract's requirements.
F1.single_run_contribution: One observation of omission or non-omission of a named requirement.
F1.repeated_and_systematically: NOT OPERATIONALIZED. No justified count or rate exists. Until a future aggregation protocol fixes one, F1 may not be reported as met or unmet.

F2.statement: Independently chosen criteria make one of the target contract's components irrelevant rather than merely unstated.
F2.single_run_contribution: A respondent's own criteria can render a component irrelevant within their own frame, observable in one run.
F2.falsifies_itself_if: The respondent's criteria are found incoherent, or the irrelevance depends on a mapper-supplied auxiliary definition.
F2.packets_required: A alone suffices; B2 strengthens it by removing the axis prompt

F3.statement: An alien formulation covers the same phenomena with materially fewer commitments under criteria the respondent independently supplied.
F3.single_run_contribution: Directly observable in one run if the respondent supplies both the formulation and the criterion.
F3.falsifies_itself_if: 'Fewer commitments' is established only under a programme-supplied criterion, or coverage is not actually equal.

F4.statement: An independently derived architecture contradicts a claimed invariant.
F4.additional_condition: Requires the architecture phase to have been run BEFORE the contamination questionnaire, and carries the S5 disclosure limitation.

F5.statement: No independently elicited formulation produces a unified answer across the respondent's own declared scope.
F5.no_independently_elicited: NOT OPERATIONALIZED as a universal. A single run can show that THIS respondent produced no unified answer; it cannot show that none does.

F6.statement: Formulation choice is consistently domain-relative across independent participants.
F6.consistently_across_participants: NOT OPERATIONALIZED. Requires multiple participants and a justified consistency criterion; neither exists yet.

falsification_conditions.governing_prohibition: It may NOT be stated that one completed run can establish whether every falsification condition is met. F1, F5 and F6 are multi-run cumulative and are currently NOT OPERATIONALIZED at the aggregate level.

strengthening_conditions.note: These would strengthen the ambition without proving it. No single positive replication establishes universality.
strengthening_conditions.S1: Independent recovery of the same conjunction of requirements.
strengthening_conditions.S2: Repeated independent architecture recovery after the separate architecture phase.
strengthening_conditions.S3: Independent justification of machinery-charging of the kind the project's admissible-representation family imposes.
strengthening_conditions.S4: Equivalent formulations under an equivalence relation the participant independently chose.

prohibited_inferences: Treating agreement across elicitation wordings as proof of naturalness.
Treating disagreement across elicitation wordings as automatic refutation.
Treating a single positive replication as establishing universality.
Treating context separation as investigator independence.
Inferring incomparability from one failed embedding direction.
Converting the neutral structural comparison relations into better or worse without a justified preference relation.
Reusing the withdrawn OP-21 global Pareto rubric.

stopping_rule.package_complete_when: Another investigator can execute R5 without making any new methodological decision that could materially affect the result.

review_loop.substantive_defect: Any defect that can change participant exposure, methodological execution, evidential warrant, target identity, role separation, contamination status, campaign interpretation, governance scope, or freeze/hash integrity.
review_loop.counter_initialization: Prospective from registration of this rule. The failure counter starts at zero. Review rounds completed before this rule existed are historical provenance and do not count toward the three-cycle failure stop.
review_loop.success_stop: After the latest substantive repair, one complete logically separate adversarial review finds zero new substantive defects, all required mechanical checks and the semantic sweep pass, and no substantive file changes occur afterward. Stop reviewing and permit merge-readiness. Re-reviewing the unchanged state is prohibited.
review_loop.reset_rule: Any substantive repair resets the clean-pass count to zero and requires exactly one logically separate adversarial review. Editorial-only corrections that cannot affect a substantive surface require validation but do not reset the loop.
review_loop.failure_stop: If three consecutive post-completion adversarial review cycles after this rule's registration each discover at least one new substantive defect, stop reviewing without merge. Mark the package REVIEW_EXHAUSTED_NOT_MERGE_READY. Further repair requires a reviewer from a different model/provider or a qualified human plus explicit authorization for another cycle.
review_loop.purpose: Bounds the review process in both directions: one clean pass ends it successfully; persistent defect discovery cannot produce an infinite self-review loop.

nonclaims: This package does not establish that R5 is obtainable, only that it is specified.

campaign_policy.rationale: No defensible sample size can be justified from current evidence. Inventing one would be pseudo-statistics, and leaving the count open would permit optional stopping after a favourable or unfavourable result.
campaign_policy.minimum_T4_runs: Not fixed by this package. Any repeated-run claim requires a future aggregation protocol registered BEFORE further runs.
campaign_policy.T5_required: No. T5 is available but not required for the single-run descriptive claims this package supports.
campaign_policy.packet_arms: A single run may use A, B1, or B2. Executing more than one arm invokes the comparison-design rules and is a multi-run activity.
campaign_policy.continuation_after_result: This package authorizes ONE run per arm as a pilot. Continuing after seeing a result is a multi-run activity requiring the aggregation protocol. This is the anti-optional-stopping control.
campaign_policy.failed_or_contaminated_runs: Preserved and reported. They do not free a slot and are not replaced silently.
campaign_policy.aggregation: None defined. No aggregation may be performed under this package.
claims_unaffected_by_campaign_stopping: Layer-1 descriptive outcomes of any completed run.
F2, F3 and F4, which are single-run testable at T4/C1.
Any recorded procedural or leakage finding.
claims_blocked_until_an_aggregation_prot: any claim about repetition, consistency, systematicity, or rates

provenance_sha_model.note: Replaces the overloaded single 'repository_base' field, which meant the evidence base in one artifact and the first protocol commit in another.
provenance_sha_model.evidence_base_sha: 3ba4986b86b6e211d9e01e78018ef8324297f86c — the commit the TARGET is pinned to, and the state whose dispositions this protocol consumed.
provenance_sha_model.protocol_current_revision_sha: recorded in provenance-manifest-v1.0.json at each refreeze; the commit whose tree the artifact hashes describe.
provenance_sha_model.pr_head_sha: the PR #445 head at the time of reading; not a protocol constant.
provenance_sha_model.self_reference_limitation: The manifest cannot contain the hash of the commit that contains it. Artifact hashes are therefore content hashes of the files, and protocol_current_revision_sha is recorded one commit behind or supplied out of band by the verifier at check time. The manifest also cannot hash itself; the verifier recomputes every other artifact hash and checks the manifest's own integrity only via git.
